'''Klaus Gunter Fischer''' (November 12, 1943 &ndash; July 2, 2009) was a German-American [[mathematician]] of [[Germany|German]] origin. He worked on a wide range of problems in [[algebraic geometry]], [[commutative algebra]], [[graph theory]], and [[combinatorics]].

Fischer was chair of the Mathematics Department at [[George Mason University]] at the time of his death.
